question: When did any system first show the CNC-01 bearing problem?
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', ts) AS day, AVG(vib_x_mm_s) AS vib_x FROM js_manuf_ice.cnc_historian.sensor_readings WHERE equipment_id='CNC-01' AND ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2024-01-15 00:00:00' AND TIMESTAMP '2024-01-20 00:00:00' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', ts) ORDER BY day
SELECT note_id, ts, text FROM cnc-demo-shift-logbook WHERE machine_id='CNC-01' AND ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2024-01-17 00:00:00' AND TIMESTAMP '2024-01-25 00:00:00' ORDER BY ts
SELECT ncr_id, opened_ts, characteristic FROM js_manuf_ice.cnc_qa.ncr WHERE machine_id='CNC-01' ORDER BY opened_ts LIMIT 1
SELECT wo_id, created_ts, problem FROM js_manuf_ice.cnc_cmms.work_orders WHERE asset_id='CNC-01' AND failure_code='BRG-WEAR' ORDER BY created_ts LIMIT 1
answer: Historian: 2024-01-17 at 12:00, when the six-hour rolling mean of VIB_X first exceeded the baseline plus 3σ. Shift logbook: LB-00208 on 2024-01-19 records a faint high-pitched whine, and LB-00209 on 2024-01-24 notes the whine is louder. QA: 2024-01-28 (NCR-24-0001) was the first roundness reject. CMMS: WO-24-0117 was raised on 2024-01-30 for the bearing.
